section_identity_desc: How this realm presents itself to members and visitors.
section_languages_desc: Choose the languages this realm supports. The primary language is the default for everyone who has not picked their own.
primary_language_error: The primary language must be one of the enabled languages.
section_branding_desc: Logo, background imagery, and primary color used across the realm UI — including main action buttons.
section_timezone_desc: The realm's official time. Times of day, such as when a proposal takes effect, are entered and shown in this zone; the realm keeps them in UTC, so changing the zone moves nothing already stored.
timezone_placeholder: Type to search, for example Europe/Madrid
timezone_applies_now: A change applies as soon as you save.
timezone_needs_vote: A change is governed by {department} (policy {policy}): saving files a proposal, and the zone changes once it is accepted.
section_journal_signing_desc: The realm's canister signs an issue of its official journal when someone asks it to, once, and keeps the signature. Each signature costs the realm cycles (about 26 billion on the production network); the realm can also sign every issue as its day closes.
journal_signing_daily: Every day, as its day closes
journal_signing_on_request_note: Costs nothing until someone asks, and at most one signature a day.
journal_signing_daily_note: One signature a day: about 9.5 trillion cycles a year. Switching to it signs, once, every day made since the last signed one: about 12 signatures (0.3 trillion cycles) for a year without any.
journal_signing_applies_now: A change applies as soon as you save.
journal_signing_needs_vote: A change is governed by {department} (policy {policy}): saving files a proposal, and it applies once it is accepted.
